title: Comparative Sequence Analysis of the Envelope Gene of Kyasanur Forest Disease Virus Vaccine Strain With Currently Circulating Field Strains.
authors: Kaje, Keerthi; Marinaik, Chandranaik B; Gomes, Amitha Reena; Rizwan, Apsana; Hiremath, Jagadish; Rathnamma, Doddamane; Isloor, Shrikrishna; Patil, Sharanagouda S; Archana, M
one_liner_zh: 该文对KFDV疫苗株与流行株的包膜基因进行序列比较，并辅以同源建模和AlphaFold结构分析，但核心是病毒学序列比对而非蛋白质结构计算建模，方法贡献较弱。
abstract: The present study was undertaken with the objective of performing comparative sequence analysis of the envelope (E) gene of Kyasanur forest disease virus (KFDV) vaccine strain P9605 with the circulating field strains. The study was taken up as the currently used KFDV vaccine strain, KFDV P9605, was isolated in the 1960s. For this study, we designed two sets of primers targeting the complete amplification of the E gene of KFDV. The sequencing was performed by the Sanger method, and the deduced sequence of the vaccine virus was deposited in GenBank with accession number PX067005. This sequence obtained for the vaccine virus was aligned and compared with sequences of GenBank-deposited circulating field strains. We also performed comparative sequence analysis of the Kyasanur forest disease (KFD) vaccine seed virus having passaged twice in mouse brain with the vaccine seed virus passaged six times in mouse brain to investigate whether multiple passages in mouse brain will lead to genetic mutation in the immunologically important E gene. The phylogenetic analysis revealed seven amino acid mutations in the field strains at positions A123T, S158N, D178E, D239N, A313S, M429I, and G479A when compared with the vaccine strain. We did not find any mutations at the critical fusogenic segment (residues 98-113) in the E gene of currently circulating field strains compared to the vaccine seed virus. The study found no genetic variations in the E gene of the KFD virus passed two times and passed six times in mouse brain. We performed SWISS-MODEL homology modeling, AlphaFold protein analysis, and Ramachandran plot analysis to study the E protein structures and stability. The observations made in this study suggest slow evolutionary drift and conserved structural stability of the envelope gene of KFDV ever since its emergence 7 decades ago; however, the functional implications of these amino acid substitutions need further studies on their roles in viral infectivity, transmission, and impact on immunity.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在对Kyasanur森林病病毒（KFDV）疫苗株P9605的包膜（E）基因与流行现场株进行比较序列分析。由于目前使用的KFDV疫苗株KFDV P9605分离于20世纪60年代，故开展本研究。为此，我们设计了两对引物，用于KFDV E基因的完整扩增。测序采用Sanger法，疫苗病毒的推导序列已提交至GenBank，登录号为PX067005。将获得的疫苗病毒序列与GenBank中收录的流行现场株序列进行比对和比较。我们还对在小鼠脑中传代两次的KFD疫苗种子病毒与在小鼠脑中传代六次的疫苗种子病毒进行了比较序列分析，以探讨小鼠脑内多次传代是否会导致免疫学上重要的E基因发生遗传突变。系统发育分析显示，与疫苗株相比，现场株在A123T、S158N、D178E、D239N、A313S、M429I和G479A位点存在七处氨基酸突变。与疫苗种子病毒相比，当前流行现场株E基因的关键融合片段（残基98-113）未发现任何突变。研究发现，在小鼠脑中传代两次和六次的KFD病毒E基因无遗传变异。我们采用SWISS-MODEL同源建模、AlphaFold蛋白分析和Ramachandran图分析来研究E蛋白的结构和稳定性。本研究观察结果表明，自KFDV出现以来的70年间，其包膜基因存在缓慢的进化漂移并保持保守的结构稳定性；然而，这些氨基酸替换的功能意义需进一步研究其在病毒传染性、传播及对免疫影响中的作用。
